372:t_004:3.en:
$$ギルター$$

$$シモン$$

$$葵$$
「He's in the camp instead of deploying...?」

372:t_005:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「He doesn't seem to be commanding infantry either...」

372:t_005:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「What is he planning, going to all the trouble of using loudspeakers and an open channel?」

372:t_005:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Japan is being attacked because of the $$神ファミリー$$! Without them, Japan would have been at peace!」

372:t_006:0.en:

372:t_006:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$神ファミリー$$, get out! Get out!!」

372:t_006:5.en:
$$青山$$
「They should just ignore what that guy says.」

372:t_006:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「This is bad! We have to pull $$ザンボット$$ back!」

372:t_006:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That bastard $$ギルター$$! What a dirty trick!!」

372:t_006:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「...During the $$多元戦争$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$, a misunderstanding once made $$勝平$$ and the $$神ファミリー$$ the target of public condemnation.」

372:t_006:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Some people believed the enemy was attacking because the $$神ファミリー$$ was there...」

372:t_006:16.en:
$n
「So those memories are tormenting $$勝平$$ and the others...!」

372:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
(I don't know who they are or where they're from, but this is the perfect chance! Heaven has sided with me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!)

372:t_007:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Look! Those are the enemies the $$神ファミリー$$ brought here!」

372:t_007:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「They're the ones responsible for bringing disaster upon Japan!」

372:t_007:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Heh heh heh, their distress is plain to see! If I strike there...!)

372:t_008:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Serves you right! Once the $$神ファミリー$$ is defeated, Japan will no longer be targeted!」

372:t_008:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「And if their friends in $c disappear too...」

372:t_009:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you doing, $$勝平$$!? Everyone believes in you!」

372:t_009:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「How can you fail to live up to that!?」

372:t_009:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Fight, $$勝平$$! Isn't that your job!?」

372:t_009:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Argh, shut up! I was so close to burying $$ザンボット３$$!」

372:t_009:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Shut up, you poisonous mushroom! $$勝平$$ would never lose to a coward like you!」

372:t_009:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$勝平$$ is amazing! No matter what happens, he never gives up or admits defeat! That's how amazing he is!」

372:t_009:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You could never understand! $$勝平$$... $$勝平$$ is...!!」

372:t_009:10.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's the friendship of boys... No, of men.」

372:t_009:12.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Then let's believe in everyone who believes in us.」

372:t_009:14.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$! The enemy is charging into town!」

372:t_009:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「Like hell I'll let that happen!」

372:t_010:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「But this thing...! It's stronger than we thought!」

372:t_010:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「At this rate, it'll push right through us...!」
